import ast,os,json,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory
from launch import LaunchContext
from launch.conditions import IfCondition
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.actions import Node
bt_dir=str(Path(get_package_share_directory('nav2_bt_navigator'))/'behavior_trees')
files={'baseline':'/baseline/ros/src/oomwoo_sim_support/launch/sim_bringup.launch.py','candidate':'/candidate/ros/src/oomwoo_sim_support/launch/sim_bringup.launch.py'}
results={}
for label,path in files.items():
 source=Path(path).read_text();f=next(n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(source)) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='navigation_setup')
 for managed in (False,True):
  records=[]
  def record_node(**kwargs):
   records.append(kwargs);return Node(**kwargs)
  controller=Node(package='nav2_controller',executable='controller_server')
  planner=Node(package='nav2_planner',executable='planner_server')
  behavior=Node(package='nav2_behaviors',executable='behavior_server')
  ns=dict(os=os,bt_dir=bt_dir,Node=record_node,LaunchConfiguration=LaunchConfiguration,with_nav=IfCondition('true'),nav2_params='/candidate/ros/src/oomwoo_sim_support/config/nav2_params.yaml',nav_common={'use_sim_time':True},controller=controller,planner=planner,behavior=behavior)
  exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[f],type_ignores=[]),path,'exec'),ns)
  ctx=LaunchContext();ctx.launch_configurations.update(managed_motion=str(managed).lower(),nav_goal_pose_topic='/valdi/quarantined_goal_pose')
  graph=ns['navigation_setup'](ctx)
  assert len(graph)==(4 if managed else 5)
  bt=next(x for x in records if x['package']=='nav2_bt_navigator')
  params=bt['parameters'][-1];selected=Path(params['default_nav_to_pose_bt_xml'])
  lifecycle=next(x for x in records if x['package']=='nav2_lifecycle_manager')
  names=lifecycle['parameters'][0]['node_names']
  assert names==(['controller_server','planner_server','bt_navigator'] if managed else ['controller_server','planner_server','behavior_server','bt_navigator'])
  if managed:
   assert params['navigators']==['navigate_to_pose']
   tree=ET.parse(selected);tags=[x.tag for x in tree.iter()]
   assert not set(tags)&{'RateController','RecoveryNode','Spin','BackUp','Wait','ClearEntireCostmap'}
   assert tags.count('ComputePathToPose')==tags.count('FollowPath')==1
   expected='navigate_w_replanning_distance.xml' if label=='candidate' else 'navigate_w_replanning_only_if_goal_is_updated.xml'
   assert selected.name==expected
   if label=='candidate':
    assert tree.find('.//DistanceController').attrib['distance']=='1.0'
    assert Path('/opt/ros/jazzy/lib/libnav2_distance_controller_bt_node.so').exists()
  else:assert selected.name=='navigate_to_pose_w_replanning_and_recovery.xml'
  results[label+('_managed' if managed else '_normal')]={'actions':len(graph),'lifecycle_names':names,'tree':selected.name,'external_goal_remap_preserved':bt['remappings'][0][0]=='goal_pose' and bt['remappings'][0][1].perform(ctx)=='/valdi/quarantined_goal_pose'}
assert Path(files['candidate']).read_text().replace('navigate_w_replanning_distance.xml','navigate_w_replanning_only_if_goal_is_updated.xml')==Path(files['baseline']).read_text()
print('DISTANCE_REPLAN_GRAPH '+json.dumps({'ok':True,'cases':results,'scope':'Actual Jazzy Node normalization and extracted unchanged navigation_setup function; no node executed. Installed XML and plugin verified; not runtime planning or navigation.'}))
